stories.title: Pakistan pressed to pick a side as Saudi-Houthi tensions escalate
stories.summary: Reuters reports Pakistan is juggling roles as Riyadh's defence partner and Washington's backchannel to Tehran and is now under pressure to choose a side. It has carried a Saudi warning to Iran to rein in the Houthis while saying no military response is under discussion.

stories.title: Iran's IRGC says it struck a US drone vessel in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said its navy hit a US 'Saildrone-type' unmanned vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, while the UK Maritime Trade Operations centre reported projectiles striking two ships off Oman. The incidents add to escalation around the world's key oil chokepoint.

stories.title: Houthis take Yemen's entire western coast and Red Sea islands
stories.summary: Yemeni officials say the Iran-backed Houthis now control the whole western coast plus the Red Sea islands of Perim and Zuqar, giving them unmatched reach over the Bab al-Mandeb strait. Whoever holds the strait can monitor vessels heading to and from the Suez Canal.

stories.title: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1 in its API
stories.summary: OpenAI added GPT-Live-1 to its developer API, giving builders access to a new live model. The release shot to the top of Hacker News, signalling heavy developer interest in low-latency, real-time AI.

stories.title: Anthropic says it blocked attempts to use AI for biological weapons
stories.summary: Anthropic's September threat-intelligence report details cases where it disrupted actors misusing Claude for cyber operations, surveillance and research that could have led to biological weapons. The disclosure follows a former top company researcher's warnings about AI risk.

stories.title: System76's Thelio Mira AI workstation packs 192 GB of GPU memory
stories.summary: Linux vendor System76 launched the Thelio Mira AI, a workstation aimed at local AI workloads with 192 GB of GPU memory. It lands as interest grows in running large models on-premises instead of in the cloud.

stories.title: Simple technique lets an untrusted site freeze a Mac
stories.summary: A write-up dubbed 'The Deathray' shows how a malicious web page can lock up a Mac, drawing hundreds of comments on Hacker News. It spotlights browser-level resource exhaustion as an underappreciated denial-of-service risk.

stories.title: Browns open at Jacksonville with Watson back under center
stories.summary: Preview coverage ahead of Sunday's season opener at the Jaguars centres on Deshaun Watson's first regular-season start in nearly two years and Todd Monken's head-coaching debut. Cleveland enters with a mostly healthy roster, with right guard Teven Jenkins' back the main question mark.

stories.title: Position-by-position look at No. 1 Ohio State vs. No. 4 Texas
stories.summary: Ahead of Saturday's prime-time rematch in Austin, a full position-by-position breakdown weighs the Buckeyes' talent against the Longhorns. The game is the first marquee test of Ohio State's 2026 season.

stories.title: Yahoo Sports picks Ohio State vs. Texas
stories.summary: Yahoo's preview lays out the odds and a pick for the Week 2 blockbuster, noting the Buckeyes are 21-9-1 against the spread since the start of 2024. It's the third straight year the two programs meet.

stories.title: F1 arrives at Madrid's new Madring circuit for the Spanish Grand Prix
stories.summary: Round 14 of 2026 takes F1 to the new 5.4 km Madring street circuit in Madrid, which replaces Barcelona as Spain's grand prix host. Kimi Antonelli arrives with a 66-point championship lead after winning Monza from 19th on the grid.

stories.title: BBC live: first practice at Madrid's Madring circuit
stories.summary: BBC Sport is running live coverage of Friday practice at the new Madring circuit, with FP1 and FP2 bookending the day. The weekend marks Madrid's debut as a Formula 1 host city.

stories.title: Spanish GP practice schedule and how to watch
stories.summary: Two Friday practice sessions and one Saturday session precede Sunday's race at Madring. Teams get their first real read on the unfamiliar street layout, with title rivals Mercedes already juggling engine penalties.

stories.title: Central Ohio marks the 25th anniversary of 9/11
stories.summary: Communities across central Ohio are holding memorial ceremonies, flag displays and stair climbs to mark 25 years since the Sept. 11 attacks, including a Statehouse flag memorial and a fire museum bell toll. Events run through the weekend.

stories.title: Bexley to get dog-friendly outdoor expansion of The Lion
stories.summary: The Lion is adding an outdoor expansion in Bexley that will welcome dogs, NBC4 reports. It's the latest change to the inner-ring suburb's dining scene.

stories.title: Columbus-area top home sales for August
stories.summary: NBC4 lists the Columbus area's top home sales for August, a periodic snapshot of the region's high-end housing market. It comes as buyers across central Ohio weigh elevated financing costs.

stories.title: 79 missing children recovered in Columbus-area operation
stories.summary: NBC4 reports that 79 missing children were found in a Columbus-area effort dubbed 'Operation Meridian'. The recovery was highlighted alongside a US Marshals arrest of a Texas murder suspect in the region.
